title: Expose a Deployment with a Service
prompt:
A Deployment `web` is running in namespace `cka-net` with its Pods serving HTTP on port `80`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create a Service named `web-svc` of type `ClusterIP` in namespace `cka-net`.
2. The Service must expose port `80` and route traffic to the Pods of the Deployment.

manifests:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
  namespace: cka-net
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: web
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: web
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: web
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80

checks.failure_hint: Create the Service with `kubectl expose` or a manifest.

checks.description: The Service responds with HTTP 200 from inside the cluster
checks.failure_hint: DNS or endpoints are not working: verify the Service selector matches the Pod labels and the targetPort is 80.

reference_solution:
Expose the Deployment.
```bash
kubectl -n cka-net expose deployment web --name=web-svc --port=80 --target-port=80 --type=ClusterIP
```
hints: Inspect the Deployment labels and containerPort using `k -n cka-net get deploy web -o yaml`.
Expose Deployment `web` on TCP port 80 and verify endpoints appear under `k -n cka-net get endpoints web-svc`.
